title: Flight barrier and trail: fast vs primed
desc: J: "the barrier when im flying and primed as well as the trail should look better or different from the fast flying activation". In game both use the same placeholder cap. F is a new fast-flight barrier; P1-P3 each fly 2 s as F, then prime (the cap folds away in 4 ticks, the primed look snaps on with a flash ring). Fast flat glide, 1 block a tick.

takes.name: Fast flight barrier (not primed)
takes.facts: thin W1-weave cap the Dome's size (4.5 blocks) with a soft rim; one quiet ribbon off the ring fist

takes.name: Primed: hex lance + twin helix
takes.facts: flies as F, primes at 2 s: a six-sided hard-light lance point 1-3.6 blocks ahead, turning slowly one way, lit edges; two ribbons wind behind

takes.name: Primed: hex ram shield + afterimages
takes.facts: flies as F, primes at 2 s: a domed shield of separate hex plates 1.8 blocks ahead, breathing; a hex afterimage ring drops behind every 4 ticks

takes.name: Primed: comet nose + pixel tail
takes.facts: flies as F, primes at 2 s: a hollow bullet nose of construct pixels 2-4 blocks ahead round a dark core; a tail of pixels shrinking out over 0.9 s
